kind: component & design system registry: accessible primitives, layout patterns, state wrappers
why: component registries expose accessible primitive structures, clean state wrappers and layout patterns that would upgrade Verse's card UI and modal containers (a standing priority is cleaning up and tying the pieces together; the Sightline layout guard is in place)
rule: Verse takes on the site with a page of its own: every feature it has, plus one notch, measured live beside it. A number not measured is shown as not measured.

features.theirs: Radix-based accessible components (dialog, popover, tooltip, dropdown) with focus traps and aria attributes
features.plus_one: the same primitives with Verse's own dark palette, no external dependency, and a one-line copy
features.progress: 2026-11-11: cards use showPage() with no focus trap or aria-live; Sightline flags overflow but not a11y.

features.theirs: design tokens for spacing, radius, colour and typography shared across components
features.plus_one: tokens derived from Verse's own palette, applied via CSS variables and validated by dark-pages check
features.progress: 2026-11-11: :root tokens exist per page but are not shared; no-ellipsis and dark-pages enforce the palette.

features.theirs: header/body/footer slots with consistent padding and border radius
features.plus_one: the same slots for the tower card, code-review card and wants card, which currently reimplement them
features.progress: 2026-11-11: not started; each card inlines its own markup.

features.plus_one: the same pattern for Verse's ask bar, timer and sticky cards
features.progress: 2026-11-11: state lives in localStorage; no controlled-state primitive.

features.theirs: one command to add a component to any project
features.plus_one: Verse's skills are already copy-paste (card-share.js); component recipes would follow the same model
features.progress: 2026-11-11: card-share.js copies a card's text; component recipes not yet published.
